title: Thunder vs. Clippers: Live updates, highlights for Friday's game
text:
Thunder vs. Clippers: Live updates, highlights for Friday's game Rumors Stats Odds Betting Newsletter OKC THUNDER Thunder vs. Clippers: Live updates, highlights for Friday's game
 Clemente Almanza OKC Thunder Wire Updated Nov. 13, 2026, 11:26 p.m. CT The Oklahoma City Thunder travel on the road to face the LA Clippers on Friday. This will be the second matchup between the two squads in the 2026-27 regular season. Last time, OKC got by with a season-altering Oct. 25 win that featured three injuries and kickstarted the Post-D.C.C. (Dub, Chet, Caso) era.
 The Thunder (8-4) are hoping to get back on track after two losses in a row. The crunch-time offense failed them in a 118-108 loss to the Portland Trail Blazers on Wednesday. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had 31 points and four rebounds. Isaiah Hartenstein enjoyed his best night of the year with 20 points, 11 rebounds and six assists.
 Meanwhile, the Clippers (2-8) continue to bottom out. They went through a 133-110 loss to the Phoenix Suns on Tuesday. Darius Garland had a forgettable 13 points and six assists
 For live updates of the Thunder's game against the Clippers, please regularly check back to this post:
 End 3Q: Thunder 84, Clippers 82
 Brilliant third quarter by the Thunder. They outscored the Clippers, 40-25, to completely flip this game. Gilgeous-Alexander is having a vintage outing with 32 points. McCain has helped with 20 points. The latter had a buzzer-beating heave. The offense is rolling finally.
 Love crosswords? Explore the Crossword page and play the new MidGrid Crossword. Half: Clippers 57, Thunder 44
 I can't believe this is OKC's reality. Everybody penciled them in as the title favorite. Now, they're just a husk of themselves. You can't even be too mad at anybody, either. Just all-time bad injury luck. Gilgeous-Alexander has 18 points, but nobody else is a semi-realistic scoring option. The Clippers aren't even playing that great, either. Which is the cynical part.
 2Q, 5:13 left: Clippers 48, Thunder 38
 Jones Jr. knocks down the outside jumper. Thunder call a timeout. There are just no other legitimate scorers in uniform outside of SGA, unfortunately. Going to fall on him.
 End 1Q: Clippers 33, Thunder 27
 Already nine free-throw attempts for Gilgeous-Alexander in this opening frame. Love to see it if you're OKC. A lot more downhill driving in this game. The Clippers are 5-of-13 from 3. They're torching the nets so far.
 1Q, 7:03 left: Clippers 20, Thunder 14
 Lopez with a couple of outside jumpers. Thunder call a timeout. Garland is absolutely dissecting their defense. Specifically, McCain. He has seven points and two assists.
 Starting lineups:
 The Thunder will start Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, Jared McCain, Kenrich Williams, Aday Mara and Isaiah Hartenstein. The Clippers will start Darius Garland, Kris Dunn, Rui Hachimura, Derrick Jones Jr. and Brook Lopez.
 What channel is Thunder vs. Clippers game on today? Time, TV schedule
 TV Channel: Thunder+, KSBI
 Start time: 9:30 p.m. CT
 Where to watch Thunder vs. Clippers on livestream
 Watch Thunder vs. Clippers live on Thunder+ Thunder vs. Clippers injury updates
 Thunder: Jalen Williams (ankle surgery) is out. Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery) is out. Chet Holmgren (knee injury recovery) is out. Ajay Mitchell (ankle sprain) is out. Jaylin Williams (back spasms) is out. Thomas Sorber (knee surgery) is out.
 Clippers: Brandon Ingram (heel surgery) is out. Bradley Beal (knee injury management) is out. Jordan Miller (torn rotator cuff) is out. Yanic Konan Niederhauser (Lisfranc surgery) is out. Nick Martinelli (G League two-way) is out.
